title: SWF runtime-sharing + Scale9: complete & byte-verify ImportAssets2/ExportAssets/DefineScalingGrid
description: VERIFIED via runtime decode of our own compiled SWF: all three encoders in compiler/symbols.ts were ALREADY correct and ALREADY emitted (frames.ts emits ExportAssets->ImportAssets2->DoInitAction in scene0/frame0; symbol pass emits DefineScalingGrid right after each DefineSprite). This task hardened the defensive tests. (a) ImportAssets2 (71): replaced .todo with a hard byte-exact assertion (STRING url + 01 00 reserved + UI16 count + {UI16 charId, STRING name}); also removed the conditional skip in the structural test. (b) ExportAssets (56): removed the non-emission fallback, added hard exactly-one + byte-exact body assertion. (c) DefineScalingGrid (78): removed all three expect.soft non-emission escape hatches, added hard exactly-one assertions + a RECT-consumes-whole-body check. Tests: swf suite 109 files / 1374 tests PASS (incl. importassets 9/9 + scalinggrid 5/5, no todo/skip). Build green. Core suite: only the 3 pre-existing task-1207 missing fixtures/flash8-empty.fla failures (unrelated, untouched). Docs: added byte-layout note to CLAUDE.md SWF-encoding learnings.
